questions.question:
다음 단어를 모두 포함하는 단어로 알맞은 것은?
excited, worried, happy, bored, curious
questions.explanation: excited, worried, happy, bored, curious는 모두 감정을 나타내는 단어들이므로 feeling이 정답입니다.

questions.question:
다음 밑줄 친 단어와 바꾸어 쓸 수 있는 것은?
I'm afraid of big dogs.
questions.explanation: afraid는 scared와 같은 의미로 '무서워하다'는 뜻입니다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
• This cloud ___________s like a rabbit.
• They often ___________ at the stars at night.
questions.explanation: 첫 번째 문장은 'look like(~처럼 보이다)', 두 번째 문장은 'look at(~을 보다)'에서 look이 공통으로 들어갑니다.

options: I have trust in my best friend. (신뢰)
The children have a fear of thunder. (두려움)
She is drawing a straight line with a ruler. (똑바로 선, 곧은)
questions.question: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 우리말 뜻이 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: uncomfortable는 '불편한'이 아니라 '편하지 않은, 불편하지만 더 정확히는 쾌적하지 않은'의 의미입니다. 이 문장에서는 'comfortable하지 않은'이라는 뜻이 맞습니다.

questions.question:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 알맞은 것은?
to be in an upright position on your feet
questions.explanation: stand는 '서 있다'라는 의미로, upright position(곧은 자세)에서 발 위에 있는 상태를 나타냅니다.

options: Can you raise your left foot?
I can raise the box onto the shelf.
She raises two children on her own.
They'll raise the flag at the ceremony.
He always raises his hat and smiles at us.
questions.question: 다음 중 밑줄 친 단어의 의미가 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: ③번은 raise가 '(아이를) 키우다'의 의미이고, 나머지는 모두 '들어올리다, 올리다'의 의미입니다.

questions.question:
다음 짝지어진 단어의 관계를 고려하여 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 단어를 쓰시오.
__________ : backward = safe : dangerous
questions.explanation: forward와 backward는 반대 의미이고, safe와 dangerous도 반대 의미이므로 forward가 정답입니다.

questions.answer: (1) have fun (2) are curious about (3) lie down
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 표현을 <보기>에서 골라 알맞은 형태로 쓰시오.
<보기> lie down, have fun, be curious about
(1) We will _____________________ at the amusement park.
(2) The children _____________________ the animals.
(3) Don't _____________________ on the cold floor.
questions.explanation: (1) will 다음에 동사원형, (2) 현재 3인칭 복수형, (3) 명령문에서 동사원형 사용

questions.question:
다음 우리말을 영작할 때 필요하지 않은 단어는?
그녀는 오후에 무엇을 공부하니?
questions.explanation: "What does she study in the afternoon?" 에서 studies는 does 다음에 동사원형 study를 써야 하므로 studies가 필요 없습니다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
I want ____________ chicken.
(나는 치킨을 먹고 싶다.)
questions.explanation: want to + 동사원형 구문에서 to eat이 올바른 형태입니다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
• ________ does she look like?
• ________ is your future dream?
questions.explanation: 첫 번째는 'What does she look like?(그녀가 생겼기 어떻게 생겼어?)', 두 번째는 'What is your future dream?(당신의 미래 꿈이 무엇입니까?)'에서 What이 공통입니다.

questions.question: 다음 빈칸에 'does'가 들어가는 문장은?
questions.explanation: ②번은 'When does the dog sleep?'로 일반동사 sleep 앞에 조동사 does가 필요합니다. ③④는 be동사 is, ⑤는 go이므로 does가 필요 없습니다.

options: I love to take a walk.
Jake decides to buy a computer.
We hope to seeing you again soon.
She plans to visit her mom this weekend.
questions.question: 다음 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 알맞지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: hope to + 동사원형이 올바른 형태이므로 'to see'가 되어야 합니다. 'to seeing'은 올바르지 않습니다.

options: He is going to study math.
My hobby is to read books.
questions.question: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 나머지와 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: ④번의 'going to'는 미래 의도를 나타내는 구문이고, 나머지는 모두 to부정사가 명사, 목적어, 보어로 사용됩니다.

options: A: Where is Hojun? B: He is in the garden.
A: What is your name? B: My name is Billy.
A: Whose book is this? B: My book is new.
A: How do you go to school? B: I go to school by bike.
A: Who is your English teacher? B: My English teacher is Mr. Kim.
questions.question: 다음 중 질문에 대한 답이 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: 'Whose book is this?(이 책은 누구의 책입니까?)'에 대한 답은 'It's mine.' 또는 '주인명 + 's book입니다. 'My book is new'는 질문에 직접 답하지 않습니다.

questions.answer: She always promises to study hard.
questions.question:
다음 우리말과 같은 의미가 되도록 주어진 <조건>에 알맞게 영작하시오. ※ 완전한 문장으로 쓰시오.
그녀는 항상 열심히 공부하겠다고 약속한다.
<조건>
• study, promise, hard, always를 사용하되, 필요시 변형할 것
• 총 6단어로 쓸 것
questions.explanation: promise to + 동사원형 구문을 사용하여 6단어로 작성합니다.
acceptedAnswers: She always promises to study hard

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 써서 대화를 완성하시오. ※ 빈칸 부분만 쓰시오.
A: What _____________ _____________ _____________ on weekends?
B: I take a violin lesson on weekends.
questions.explanation: "What do you do on weekends?"의 형태로 현재 일반적인 행동을 묻는 질문입니다.

questions.answer: (1) When do you go on a picnic (2) She plans to study English
questions.question:
다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 괄호 안의 말을 이용하여 <보기>와 같이 문장을 완성하세요. (필요시 변형 또는 추가할 것)
<보기> 그는 요즘 왜 그렇게 바쁘니? (be / busy / so) → Why is he so busy these days?
너는 언제 친구들과 함께 소풍을 가니? (a picnic / on / go)
(1)__________________________________ with your friends?
그녀는 매일 아침 영어를 공부할 계획이다. (study / plan / English)
(2)__________________________________ every morning.
questions.explanation: (1)는 언제를 물어보는 의문문, (2)는 계획을 나타내는 문장입니다.
acceptedAnswers: (1)When do you go on a picnic (2)She plans to study English

questions.question:
다음 표현들의 공통된 의도로 알맞은 것은?
• How does he look?
• What does he look like?
• Can you tell me what he looks like?
questions.explanation: 모두 어떤 대상의 외모나 모습을 묘사하도록 요구하는 표현입니다.

options: does your dog like to bark
questions.question:
[지문]
B: Are you here with your dog?
G: Yes, my dog, Cooper, is playing over there. He's so excited.
B: Umm ... ________________________________?
G: He is white, and he has a short tail.

다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: 뒤에 '그는 흰색이고 짧은 꼬리가 있습니다'라는 외모 설명이 오므로 'what does he look like?'가 적절합니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Hojin: Jenny, ⓐcan you help me, please?
Jenny: Sure, Hojin. ⓑWhat's up?
Hojin: ⓒI can't find my dog, Bella.
Jenny: Really? What does Bella look like?
Hojin: ⓓShe looks really happy all the time.
Jenny: Okay. ⓔLet's find her together
Hojin: Thank you so much.

다음 대화의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 흐름상 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: Jenny가 'What does Bella look like?'를 물었는데, Hojin이 'She looks really happy all the time'이라고 답하는 것은 외모가 아닌 성격을 설명하고 있어 흐름에 맞지 않습니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
B: Mom, there's my English teacher, Ms. Lee.
W: What does she look like?
B: She has long brown hair. She is wearing a green jacket.
W: Oh, that's her! Let's say hello to her.

다음 대화에 언급된 내용으로 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: 대화에서 'She is wearing a green jacket'이라고 명시되어 있으므로 영어 선생님의 재킷 색깔이 녹색임이 언급되었습니다.

options: Can I help you with something?
questions.question:
[지문]
1.
W: (A)____________________________________
M: Sure, Emily. What is it?
W: This table is heavy. I want to move it over there.
M: Okay. Let's do it together.
2.
A: (B)____________________________________ I'm looking for my sister.
B: What does she look like?
A: She has short brown hair.
B: Oh, there she is!
A: Thank you so much.

다음 대화의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: 두 대화 모두 누군가에게 도움을 요청하는 상황이므로 'Can you help me, please?'가 적절합니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
I'm Michael from Animal Care Center. We help street animals. (A) Look at the baby cat on the tree! It is gray, and it has black ears. (B) It is scared. Let's help it! (C) Many street animals need our help. (D) We need volunteers. (E) Can you help us, please?

윗글의 (A)~(E) 중, 주어진 문장이 들어갈 알맞은 곳은?
Whew, it is safe now.
questions.explanation: 'Whew, it is safe now.'은 고양이가 나무에서 안전하게 구해진 후 나올 문장이므로 (C) 앞에 위치하는 것이 자연스럽습니다.

options: Michael works at the Animal Care Center.
The Animal Care Center helps animals in zoos.
The baby cat on the tree is gray with black ears.
Many street animals need help from people.
The Animal Care Center needs volunteers.
questions.question:
[지문]
I'm Michael from Animal Care Center. We help street animals. (A) Look at the baby cat on the tree! It is gray, and it has black ears. (B) It is scared. Let's help it! (C) Many street animals need our help. (D) We need volunteers. (E) Can you help us, please?

윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
questions.explanation: 지문에서 'We help street animals'이라고 했으므로 동물원 동물을 돕는다는 내용은 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
A: Can you help me, please?
(A) No problem.
(B) Can you fix my bike?
(C) Sure. What is it?

다음 주어진 대화에 이어질 순서로 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: 자연스러운 대화 흐름은 (C) Sure. What is it? → (B) Can you fix my bike? → (A) No problem. 입니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Hojin: Jenny, (A)can you help me, please?
Jenny: Sure, Hojin. What's up?
Hojin: I can't find my dog, Bella.
Jenny: Really? What does Bella look like?
Hojin: She is white and yellow. She has big ears.
Jenny: Okay. Let's find her together.
Hojin: Thank you so much.

위 대화의 밑줄 친 (A)의 의도로 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: 'Can you help me, please?'는 상대방에게 도움을 요청하는 표현입니다.

options: Hojin is looking for his dog.
questions.question:
[지문]
Hojin: Jenny, (A)can you help me, please?
Jenny: Sure, Hojin. What's up?
Hojin: I can't find my dog, Bella.
Jenny: Really? What does Bella look like?
Hojin: She is white and yellow. She has big ears.
Jenny: Okay. Let's find her together.
Hojin: Thank you so much.

위 대화의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
questions.explanation: Hojin이 'I can't find my dog, Bella'라고 말했으므로 Hojin이 자신의 개를 찾고 있습니다.

options: Her favorite food is an apple.
She is black, and she has a long tail.
questions.question:
[지문]
B: Hi, Wendy. Where is your dog?
G: She is over there. She's playing with a ball.
B: Hmm, what does she look like?
G: _____________________________________ B: Oh, I see her.

다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: 'What does she look like?'는 외모를 묻는 질문이므로 외모 설명인 'She is black, and she has a long tail'이 적절합니다.

questions.question:
다음 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오. ※ 빈칸 부분만 쓰시오.
What does she look like? = ___________ ___________ ___________ ___________?
questions.explanation: 'What does she look like?'와 'How does she look?'은 같은 의미입니다.

questions.answer: (1) She has long brown hair. (2) She is wearing a green jacket.
questions.question:
[지문]
B: Mom, there's my English teacher, Ms. Lee.
W: What does she look like?
B: (1)그녀는 긴 갈색 머리를 하고 있다. (2)그녀는 녹색 재킷을 입고 있다.
W: Oh, that's her! Let's say hello to her.

다음 대화의 밑줄 친 (1), (2)의 우리말을 주어진 <조건>에 알맞게 영작하시오.
<조건>
• have, wear를 사용할 것 (필요시 변형할 것)
• (1)은 5단어, (2)는 6단어로 영작할 것
questions.explanation: (1)은 have를 사용한 소유 표현, (2)는 wear의 현재진행형을 사용합니다.
acceptedAnswers: (1) She has long brown hair. (2) She is wearing a green jacket
(1)She has long brown hair. (2)She is wearing a green jacket.

questions.question:
[지문]
<보기> help, can
A: _____________________________, please?
B: Okay. How may I help you?
A: Can you return these books for me?
B: Sure.

다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 <보기>의 단어를 사용하여 알맞게 영작하시오. (단, 4단어로 쓸 것)
questions.explanation: 'Can you help me, please?'에서 4단어 부분을 채웁니다.

options: How can the cat feel safe?
What is the cat looking at?
Why does the cat feel happy?
questions.question:
[지문]
The first cat is showing its belly. What does this mean? Is it afraid of something? Not at all! This action shows its trust. The cat also feels safe now. The second cat's ears are forward, and the tail is up. Its tail looks like a question mark. (A)_____________________________? It feels happy. Maybe it also wants (B)___________ playtime.

윗글의 빈칸 (A)에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: 뒤에 'It feels happy'라는 감정 설명이 오므로 고양이의 감정을 묻는 'How does the cat feel?'이 적절합니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
The first cat is showing its belly. What does this mean? Is it afraid of something? Not at all! This action shows its trust. The cat also feels safe now. The second cat's ears are forward, and the tail is up. Its tail looks like a question mark. (A)_____________________________? It feels happy. Maybe it also wants (B)___________ playtime.

윗글의 빈칸 (B)에 들어갈 알맞은 형태는?
questions.explanation: want to + 동사원형 구문이므로 'to have'가 올바른 형태입니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
The first cat is showing its belly. What does this mean? Is it afraid of something? Not at all! This action shows its trust. The cat also feels safe now. The second cat's ears are forward, and the tail is up. Its tail looks like a question mark. (A)_____________________________? It feels happy. Maybe it also wants (B)___________ playtime.

윗글의 제목으로 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: 고양이들의 몸짓과 자세를 통해 감정을 설명하는 글이므로 'Cats' Body Language'가 제목으로 가장 적절합니다.

options: 첫 번째 고양이는 턱을 보여주고 있다.
첫 번째 고양이는 신뢰를 보여주고 있다.
두 번째 고양이의 귀는 뒤로 향해 있다.
두 번째 고양이의 꼬리는 아래로 향하고 있다.
두 번째 고양이는 무언가를 두려워하고 있다.
questions.question:
[지문]
The first cat is showing its belly. What does this mean? Is it afraid of something? Not at all! This action shows its trust. The cat also feels safe now. The second cat's ears are forward, and the tail is up. Its tail looks like a question mark. (A)_____________________________? It feels happy. Maybe it also wants (B)___________ playtime.

윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
questions.explanation: 지문에서 'This action shows its trust'라고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
(A)___________ do these dogs want to say?
The first dog is bowing. It is saying, "I want to play with you." The dog feels ⓐ____________, and it wants to have fun right now. Look at the second dog. The dog's head is low, its ears are back, and its tail is down. This body language shows ⓑ____________. The dog is scared of something. It needs to be alone for a moment.

윗글의 빈칸 (A)에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: 'What do these dogs want to say?'는 강아지들이 무엇을 말하고 싶어 하는지 묻는 의문문입니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
(A)___________ do these dogs want to say?
The first dog is bowing. It is saying, "I want to play with you." The dog feels ⓐ____________, and it wants to have fun right now. Look at the second dog. The dog's head is low, its ears are back, and its tail is down. This body language shows ⓑ____________. The dog is scared of something. It needs to be alone for a moment.

윗글의 빈칸 ⓐ, ⓑ에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 연결된 것은?
questions.explanation: 첫 번째 개는 놀고 싶어서 'excited'이고, 두 번째 개는 두려워하므로 'fear'입니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
(A)이 토끼들은 무엇을 생각하고 있을까?
The first rabbit is standing on its back legs. It is ⓐ(raise) its front legs, and its ears are (B)___________. Is it ⓑ(worry) about something? Not really. The rabbit is curious about something. The second rabbit is lying down like Superman. It is stretching its legs. Why is it doing that? Is it sick? Don't worry. The rabbit is saying, "I feel so comfortable."

윗글의 밑줄 친 (A)의 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 알맞게 배열할 때, 네 번째로 오는 단어는?
<보기> are / what / rabbits / thinking / these
questions.explanation: 'What are these rabbits thinking?'에서 네 번째 단어는 'rabbits'입니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
(A)이 토끼들은 무엇을 생각하고 있을까?
The first rabbit is standing on its back legs. It is ⓐ(raise) its front legs, and its ears are (B)___________. Is it ⓑ(worry) about something? Not really. The rabbit is curious about something. The second rabbit is lying down like Superman. It is stretching its legs. Why is it doing that? Is it sick? Don't worry. The rabbit is saying, "I feel so comfortable."

윗글의 괄호 ⓐ, ⓑ에 주어진 단어의 형태가 알맞게 연결된 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ는 현재진행형 'raising', ⓑ는 과거분사 'worried'(be worried about) 형태입니다.

questions.question:
